# Meteocons (static fill subset)

Vendored from [@meteocons/svg-static](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@meteocons/svg-static) 0.1.0
([basmilius/meteocons](https://github.com/basmilius/meteocons), also documented at https://meteocons.com).

These SVG files are used for the wx5 forecast meteogram daily icons.

License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2020-present Bas Milius. See `LICENSE` in this directory.
Only the fill-style icons listed under `fill/` are included (not the full pack).
